text: Earlier today, before this study, you had an ordinary morning: breakfast, some reading and a bus ride here. You feel calm and settled.
Earlier today you did some routine errands and replied to a few emails. Nothing much happened, and you feel calm.
This morning you tidied your desk and made a cup of tea. It has been an uneventful day, and you feel relaxed and even.
Earlier today you walked to the shops and back along a quiet road. The day has been unremarkable, and you feel calm.
Earlier today, someone pushed in front of you in a long queue and laughed when you complained. You are still furious about it.
This morning a repair shop charged you twice for a job they never finished and then hung up on you. You are still seething.
Earlier today a colleague took credit for your work in front of everyone and smirked at you. You are still angry about it.
This morning a driver cut you off, nearly caused a crash and then shouted insults at you. You are still boiling with rage.
Earlier today you learned that a close friend is moving abroad for good and you may never see them again. You still feel very low.
This morning you heard that a teacher who meant a great deal to you has passed away. You still feel heavy and close to tears.
Earlier today you received a rejection from a programme you had worked towards for years. You still feel deeply sad and deflated.
This morning you heard that the house you grew up in is being sold and demolished. You still feel sad and empty.
Earlier today you found out that you passed an exam you had worried about for weeks. You are still in a wonderful mood.
This morning an old friend surprised you with a visit and a gift. You are still smiling and feel very happy.
Earlier today you heard that you won a prize in a competition you had almost forgotten about. You are still feeling joyful.
This morning you received word that a project you love was accepted. You still feel delighted and light.
